title: Enterprise Compliance Onramp Accelerator: templated evidence bundles & rapid-response lane
creator: Aisha Gupta
description:
Goal: Build a fast, repeatable onramp for high-touch enterprise security & compliance requests that reduces time-to-first-response and eliminates repeated manual evidence assembly. The feature will provide: 1) Pre-built evidence bundle templates (SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA) that map to the most common questionnaire asks; 2) An automated questionnaire parser to classify asks and attach a suggested evidence bundle; 3) A high-priority fast lane (SLA: 3 business days for top-tier accounts) that surfaces prefilled responses to a security reviewer and a customer success rep; 4) Audit trail and downloadable evidence export for customers.

Background: We continue to get repeated enterprise requests that require manual collection of artifacts (policies, signing logs, architecture diagrams). This creates long backlog time and inconsistent answers. Sales and CS report lost momentum due to slow compliance responses.

Scope: Deliver templates and the intake workflow for Hosted API customers and Dedicated accounts. Integrations: Reducing manual effort for Security reviewers via a console view and Slack notifications; optional export for customers; hooks for CS tools (Zendesk/Gainsight) via webhooks.

Non-goals: This ticket does not include on-prem packaging for self-service evidence rotation or full document redaction flows (these are follow-ups).

Acceptance criteria:
- Product: Templates for SOC2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA exist as editable bundles in Console and can be attached to an intake request.
- Automation: Questionnaire parser classifies >= 85% of incoming vendor questionnaire items into our template sections on initial run (measured on a seeded set of 120 past questionnaires).
- SLA: When a request is flagged as high-touch (customer tier >= Platinum), the fast lane surfaces a prefilled evidence bundle to reviewers within 24 hours and full response within 3 business days.
- UX: Console flow allows reviewer to accept, edit, or request more context; every change creates an audit entry downloadable with request ID.
- Metrics: Reduce average time-to-first-response from current 10 business days to <= 3 business days for fast-lane requests; reduce manual evidence assembly time per request by 60%.
